area: calibration UI (views/setup/calibration.ejs + routes/setup/calibration.js + server/calibration/router.js) — full findings written to /tmp/v11-calib-surfaces.md

findings.title: Sweep Test drives an unmeasured servo 0-180 x3 at 100% while the UI shows the placeholder span as if measured
findings.evidence: GET /api/calibration/15/profile returned bounds {0,180} with autoGenerated:true, calibrated:false; updateCalibrationUI (calibration.ejs:1178) renders profile.bounds raw with no placeholder indicator and the GET's calibrated flag is used nowhere in the view (grep); runSweepTest uses currentCalProfile.bounds at speedPct:100; router.js goto clamps with calibratedBounds() which withholds a placeholder span, so no clamp applies and hardware-safety.json is empty
findings.failure_scenario: Operator selects Forearm Rotation (Orlok part 5, travel never measured, shares the blown-fuse rail with part 4), sees 'Min 0 / Max 180' rendered as fact, presses Sweep Test -> servo driven 0-180 three times at full speed into unknown mechanical stops
findings.fix: In updateCalibrationUI show 'unmeasured/placeholder' when calibrated:false, and make runSweepTest refuse (or loudly confirm) on a placeholder profile
findings.characters_affected: All; concretely Orlok parts 4, 5, 15 today (placeholder profiles on this node)

findings.title: Marker editor is dead (DOM never rendered) yet markers remain the live jaw/head guardrail fallback; jaw markers hold known-bad 63/131 one Clear-click from taking effect
findings.evidence: All marker wiring (calibration.ejs:3785-4010) targets ids setMinBtn/minValue/customMarkers/newMarkerName/addMarkerBtn that exist in NO view (grep across views/); jawAnimationSuperPowerService.js:461-494 falls back to part.markers when the profile is missing/placeholder; live data: jaw profile bounds 33-98 (measured) vs markers Min 63/Max 131, which the service's own comment calls 'past the mechanical stops'
findings.failure_scenario: Operator presses the panel's Clear button on the jaw (DELETE /api/calibration/10/profile) to re-calibrate; jaw guardrails silently switch to the invisible markers 63/131 and the next jaw-synced audio grinds the jaw past its mechanical stop, with no UI anywhere showing or editing those numbers
findings.fix: Restore the markers card markup or retire markers with a migration; at minimum make Clear warn when markers exist and name their values
findings.blast_radius: calibration.ejs + one-time data cleanup of parts.json markers
findings.characters_affected: Orlok jaw concretely; any character with stale markers

findings.title: Two invert toggles write different keys honored by different execution paths: capability.invert (calibration moves) vs config.invertDirection (runtime scenes/poses)
findings.evidence: Panel toggle -> /api/calibration/:id/set-invert -> profile capability.invert, honored only by the calibration adapters (router.js:816-822); Edit tab writes config.invertDirection (calibration.ejs:5271-5279), honored only by controlPart paths (hardwareService/index.js:256-276,763-839, poseEngine.js:204); the runtime absolute-servo path servo.moveToAngle takes no invert at all (index.js:662), and router.js:92 states part.config.invert is undefined for every part
findings.failure_scenario: Operator inverts a backwards-wired servo via the calibration panel, verifies motion and saves poses; at show time the scene/pose path ignores capability.invert and plays every position mirrored (verified 120 deg becomes 60 deg)
findings.fix: One canonical invert key consulted by both paths (have set-invert also write config.invertDirection, or make hardwareService read the profile), remove the duplicate toggle

findings.title: Safety tab (Current limit A / Timeout ms) is a dead control: never loaded, never saved, read by nothing
findings.evidence: Repo-wide grep: safetyCurrent/safetyTimeout appear only at calibration.ejs:730/734 (the input definitions); the tab and tooltip promise 'current limits and timeout thresholds for safe operation' (line 565); no current-draw cap exists anywhere in software per operator ruling and hardware-safety.json is empty
findings.failure_scenario: Operator enters 8A on the coffin actuator believing an over-current shutoff now protects the circuit that has blown fuses, then runs risky loads trusting a limit that stores and enforces nothing
findings.fix: Delete the Safety tab (nothing to migrate)

findings.title: Simple Calibration card is a ghost duplicate of the real Set Min/Set Max: writes config.simpleCalibration (read by nothing, lint-banned), captures the textbox value not the hardware position, delete button hits a nonexistent route
findings.evidence: simpleCalibration consumers: only routes/setup/calibration.js itself and eslint-rules/no-legacy-calibration.js:30 where the identifier is banned as legacy; sc_currentValue (calibration.ejs:4025) reads the angNum input, not /position; sc_del calls DELETE /api/simple/:id/points/:name while the router defines only GET/set-safe/points POST (lines 770/796/833) - the 404 HTML makes r.json() throw into an empty catch
findings.failure_scenario: Operator calibrates limits via 'Set Minimum/Set Maximum' here (success toasts), but scenes/poses/jaw/sweep all read calibration_profiles.json which this card never touches - a full calibration session with zero effect; deleting a saved point silently does nothing
findings.fix: Delete the card and the three /api/simple routes

findings.title: Edit-tab Save Changes rebuilds config from scratch and the PUT replaces it wholesale, erasing keys written by other tabs (motion/head-tracking tuning, overrides); the Advanced JSON textarea is display-only for most part types
findings.evidence: getEditConfigValues builds a fresh config with a per-type whitelist (webcam: 5 keys; servo: 7 keys); routes/setup/calibration.js:578 spreads updates so updates.config replaces config; Advanced tab saves config.motionTracking/headTracking (calibration.ejs:2334-2356) which the webcam whitelist omits; the editConfig JSON textarea is only read back in the motor/linear_actuator/stepper branches (5155-5200)
findings.failure_scenario: Operator tunes head tracking (saved into webcam config), later fixes fps on the Edit tab and hits Save -> tracking tuning and pan-servo assignment silently destroyed; JSON typed into 'Advanced Configuration' for a servo is silently discarded
findings.fix: Merge config on PUT (or seed getEditConfigValues from {...selected.config}); honor or remove the JSON textarea per type
findings.blast_radius: one route handler or one view function

findings.title: Mic Sensitivity slider is a total no-op and Gain never persists: both persist via GET /setup/calibration/api/parts/:id which does not exist
findings.evidence: Router defines GET /api/parts, /:id/effective, /:id/markers only (routes/setup/calibration.js:412/748/890, single mount server.js:433); the sensitivity flow (3211) and gain persist flow (3241, also 6321) GET the bare :id, get Express's 404 HTML, r.json() rejects into an empty catch - no save, no error shown; sensitivity has no live-apply call so persistence was its only effect
findings.failure_scenario: Operator sets mic sensitivity for the show: slider moves, nothing changes anywhere, no feedback; sets input gain: works until reboot then silently reverts (the documented 'settings that mysteriously revert' class)
findings.fix: Add a character-aware GET /api/parts/:id (mirrors siblings) or PUT directly using the already-loaded selected.config
findings.characters_affected: Orlok and Mina (XVF3800 mics) concretely; all mics

findings.title: Continuous-servo CW/CCW jog silently stops moving hardware once the estimated position hits the 0/1 rail, while reporting success each press
findings.evidence: CW button posts nudge {delta:+0.1} (calibration.ejs:2790-2800); nudge clamps newP to [0,1] then calls gotoNormalized; ContinuousServoAdapter.js:172-175 returns {success:true,'Already at target'} without any hardware command when delta<0.01; UI shows 'cw complete'
findings.failure_scenario: Calibrating a continuous servo (Sir Dragomir's neck class), five CW presses from center saturate the estimate at 1.0; every further CW press reports success and moves nothing - reads exactly like dead hardware, or convinces the operator the part is at its real end when it is not
findings.fix: Return/display 'estimated position at end of range - use raw jog or reset position' when the clamp saturates instead of success
findings.blast_radius: ~10 lines in nudge handler or adapter
findings.characters_affected: Any character with continuous servos (Dragomir neck per fleet notes)

findings.title: Overrides can never be removed: blank fields are skipped, Revert-to-Model is a server-side no-op (merge of {}), and the Effective panel updates optimistically even on failed saves
findings.evidence: config = { ...prev, ...overrides } can never delete a key so Revert's overrides:{} changes nothing (view 2168-2175); collectOverrideFields skips empty inputs (2056-2063); view comment at 2124 admits it updates the Effective panel 'regardless of backend outcome to satisfy UX expectations'
findings.failure_scenario: Operator clears a mistaken channel:5 override (or presses Revert to Model), watches the Effective panel update - but parts.json still carries channel 5 and the servo keeps driving the wrong PCA9685 channel
findings.fix: Make the overrides POST replace (or accept null-to-delete) and drop the optimistic Effective update

findings.title: Servo Min/Max/Neutral Pulse and Rotation Range override fields are ghosts - the runtime drive path never reads them
findings.evidence: OVERRIDE_SCHEMAS.servo offers minPulse/maxPulse/neutralPulse/rotationRangeDeg; the PCA9685 standard path sends only channel+angle to the daemon/servo_cli.py (hardwareService/index.js:687-689) with pulse mapping hardcoded in the wrapper; pca9685.js moveServoToAngle accepts pulse params but no caller passes part.config values; hardware skill documents the same keys as dead data
findings.failure_scenario: Servo reaches only ~160 deg; operator raises Max Pulse to 2500 in Model/Overrides, sees it in Effective (merged), physical travel never changes, rig time burned chasing it
findings.fix: Remove the four fields from OVERRIDE_SCHEMAS.servo

findings.title: Two parallel calibration pages exist; the Calibrated trust stamp (which gates whether runtime honors measured bounds) is only on the non-nav-linked unified page
findings.evidence: POST /api/calibration/:partId/calibrated (router.js:270-343) is called only from unified-calibration.ejs:547; nav links only /setup/calibration (unified-navigation.ejs:68); the main page neither displays nor toggles calibrated/autoGenerated (grep: GET's calibrated field unused)
findings.failure_scenario: Operator measures bounds on the main page but the part is un-stamped; calibratedBounds() withholds his window from every runtime consumer and the page he uses gives him no way to see or fix that
findings.fix: Surface calibrated status + stamp toggle on the main page, then retire or clearly mark the unified page

findings.title: Motor/stepper/light/LED test buttons report Done without checking success (fetch resolves on 500s; simulated:true also reads Done)
findings.evidence: Motor Run (3015-3019), stepper (3049-3062), light (3071-3078), LED (3084-3091) set 'Done' in a bare .then with no .ok/success/simulated check, unlike the servo branch which checks data.success
findings.failure_scenario: A refused, failed, or simulated move on a motor shows 'Done' after 800ms (while a real run would last 15000ms by default) - operator concludes hardware works when nothing moved
findings.fix: Check response.ok and data.success (and surface simulated:true) in the four handlers

findings.title: addPreset writes {position} while the scene executor reads only {angle|p} - open-loop presets captured on this page resolve to NaN in scenes
findings.evidence: addPreset stores {name, position, angle?}; sceneExecutor.js:70/87/112 reads preset.angle or preset.p, never position; routes/setup/calibration.js savePosition writes {angle,p} - two writers, two shapes
findings.failure_scenario: Operator saves a preset for a linear actuator on this page (only 'position' stored), a scene references it, executor computes targetP=undefined -> NaN duration/angle at show time while the on-page Goto works (its fallback reads position), hiding the defect until the show
findings.fix: Write p (keep position for backcompat) in addPreset

findings.title: ?characterId is resolved server-side then ignored by the client; four routes resolve character differently from their siblings (GET markers via selectedCharacter, model/overrides via global loadParts, standard_servo move calls controlPart without characterId)
findings.evidence: Render passes currentCharacterId (routes/setup/calibration.js:391) but the view never references it (grep: zero uses) - all flows use __MB_CHAR_ID = selectedCharacter; getMarkersForPart uses readConfig().selectedCharacter (872-887) while POST markers uses resolveCharacter; /api/parts/:id/model and /overrides use global loadParts/saveParts (637-674); /api/standard_servo/:id/move calls controlPart without {characterId} (1288) against the CLAUDE.md rule
findings.failure_scenario: Deep link /setup/calibration?characterId=2 silently shows and edits the selected character's data; any future client use of the param turns the four divergent routes into cross-character reads/writes on same-numbered parts
findings.fix: Strip or honor the param end-to-end; align the four routes with loadCharacterParts/resolveCharacter and pass characterId to controlPart
findings.characters_affected: All, multi-character data on one node

findings.title: lastCalibratedAt is stamped on every store write including auto-create, so a never-calibrated part reports a fresh calibration timestamp
findings.evidence: upsert stamps lastCalibratedAt unconditionally; live GET /api/calibration/15/profile shows a today timestamp with calibrated:false on an untouched part; routes/setup/calibration.js:109 reports it as calibration status
findings.failure_scenario: Any UI/report reading lastCalibratedAt tells the operator an uncalibrated part was calibrated today
findings.fix: Only stamp when bounds/pulses actually change (or rename the field where auto-created)

findings.title: Orphaned save-pulse endpoint fabricates min=0/center=90/max=180 presets as a side effect; retired UI (dead markers wiring) is its only historical caller
findings.evidence: save-pulse auto-saves positions at fabricated angles 0/90/180 (1318-1326); grep across views/ and public/js finds no caller of save-pulse/save-position (only the /move sibling inside the dead markers block, calibration.ejs:3856)
findings.failure_scenario: Any future or scripted caller saving a pulse silently creates replayable presets at angles the servo was never measured at (e.g. 'max'=180 on a 33-98 jaw)
findings.fix: Remove the auto-preset block or the whole orphaned endpoint pair with the markers cleanup

findings.title: Calibration profiles are never reconciled when a part changes type: profile 3:14 is an absolute-servo with measured bounds while part 14 is now a motion sensor
findings.evidence: Live file holds 3:14 kind absolute-servo, autoGen false, bounds 2-180; character-3/parts.json part 14 is 'Sensor for Orlok' motion_sensor; channel reconcile in router.js:126-142 covers continuous servos only
findings.failure_scenario: A part id re-used or re-typed inherits a wrong-kind profile; profile listings and the scene editor's profiles dump show bounds for a sensor
findings.fix: Reconcile or flag kind-vs-part-type mismatches on load (like the existing channel reconcile)

unverified: Phantom 'Auto Webcam' injection (routes/setup/calibration.js:427 pushes a fake part in production when parts.length <= 1): condition not reachable with any current character's data (all fleet parts.json files here have 3+ parts), so not filed as a finding.
Whether any operator workflow still reaches /setup/calibration/unified in practice - only the legacy redirect URLs point at it; could not observe real usage.
Physical outcomes (fuse blow, jaw stop damage) are inferred from the documented incident history in CLAUDE.md/skills, not reproduced - no hardware was commanded during this audit.

F8/continuous premise that Sir Dragomir part 1 currently carries servoType 'continuous' comes from memory/skill notes; Dragomir's parts.json is node-local to 192.168.8.130 and was deliberately not read from this node per the fleet rule.

The DELETE /api/simple/:id/points/:name 404 was proven by route grep (no such route registered, single mount at server.js:433) rather than a live request - the mutation-shaped curl was blocked by policy.
